description: This is a Java implementation of the ZoneService interface, providing methods to retrieve and manipulate geographical zone data, with caching and database interaction.

classes.name: ZoneServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ZoneService interface, providing zone retrieval, addition of descriptions, and caching functionalities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a Zone entity by its code.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Add a description to a Zone object, updating if necessary.

methods.name: getZones (Country, Language)
methods.description: Get list of zones for a specific country and language, using cache if available.

methods.name: getZones (Language)
methods.description: Get map of zones keyed by code for a specific language, with caching.
